methods.what: Condition for a line integral to depend only on its endpoints (exactness condition)
methods.quote: $\int X dx + Y dy$ [-=0-] $\frac{\partial X}{\partial y} - \frac{\partial Y}{\partial x} = 0$

methods.quote: $\int\left(\frac{\partial X}{\partial y} - \frac{\partial Y}{\partial x}\right) \partial x \partial y = -\int\left(X dx + Y dy\right)$
